name: Rengo Co., Ltd.
summary: Rengo Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells paperboard and packaging-related products in Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Paperboard and Paper Processing-Related Business; Flexible Packaging-Related Business; Heavy Duty Packaging-Related Business; Overseas Business; and Other Businesses segments. It offers paperboard products, such as containerboards, boxboards, tube boards, chipboards, processed paper products; corrugated packaging products, including smart display packaging, functional and decorative corrugated products, and support systems for e-commerce packaging, as well as materials for distribution, shipping, and construction;…
